text: Who wants a window seat. I can book the 6:40 thu if we're doing the train
I'll take aisle. Window for you Erin if you want it
Ok window
Is the 6:40 the Empire Builder or the regional? They want the operator name on the reimbursement form
Regional. Goes to chicago then you change. The 7:15 has one facing pair left but kwame says facing is bad for knees
Facing seats are a pain with knees. I'd take the 6:40
Sorry was in a lab meeting. Whatever gets us there by noon is fine
Are we booking through the company portal or paying and claiming
Portal won't do a group. I'll buy 4 separately and forward the confirmations
Forward them to me too. Keep the e-ticket PDFs, not screenshots
[photo: seat map with the 6:40 highlighted]
Car 3 is the quiet one
Bought them. 6:40 thu, car 3. Me window, jonah you're facing, kwame and joan across the aisle
Great
No offense to facing
Got them. Erin, did you pay on the company card or your own?
Own. Card got declined on the portal anyway. Will claim
Fine. Send me the amounts when you have a minute, I'll need them in one place
Hotel in Chicago is near the station right? I'll look at the walk
About 12 min. There's a cab line too. Not doing the walk with luggage in december
Fair
Erin, amounts?
Sorry. 4 x 61.50 for the train plus a 14 dollar seat reservation on mine. Think its 14, will check the receipt
Thank you. I'll check against the PDFs
Anyone know if the cafe car takes card
Probably. I'd bring cash anyway
Checked the receipt. Seat is 14.50, the fee was 50c more than I remembered. Sorry
No problem. Total is 260.50 then. I'll update the sheet
Thanks for checking
Who's driving to target station thu
Not me, I'm getting a ride from my neighbor at 5:45. Can drop someone
I'll get a cab. Less parking hassle
I'll drive. Will be there 6:05 if anyone wants a lift before that
Ok. I'll take the cab with kwame, I don't have a car here right now
Is 6 too early for a cab
Nope. 6 is fine. Cab line is never short at that hour
Printed the tickets, they are in my bag. Anyone want paper or are phones ok
Phone for me. Printing the PDFs too just in case
Hotel confirmed. Check in after 3 so we can drop bags
Erin you're in the room next to mine right?
Yes, 312. Thats the one
Charged my phone, packing now. Forgot a charger last time
Good thinking
Alarm set for 4:50. Night all
Up. Cab for 5:40. Jonah I'll pick you up at the corner
Ok. I'll be out front
Neighbor's here. Heading out
At the station. Lines are short
Parked in the lot by the north entrance. Where is everyone
Inside by the board. Cab got us here early
Be right there
Did anyone get coffee
Yes. Erin want one
I'm ok, thanks
Left my reading glasses on the dash. Going back
Train is on the platform. Car 3 is the one at the front end
Got them. Boarding now
